target: - For a declared exit-only comparison, verify the full enabled entry objects, order and technology are unchanged, then independently replay the complete portfolio path on the same window, coins, data, risk and costs. Different holding times change occupancy, future entries and compounded sizing; deleting old exits or trade groups is descriptive attribution, not the new candidate's PnL.
content: - For successive close-rule refinements, record the exact current, immediate-parent and actual audit-comparator snapshots and hashes separately. Pair old/new/both/added-only decisions on every actual closing environment; if the comparator is an earlier ancestor, label counts relative to that ancestor rather than claiming they are changes versus the immediate parent. Independently exercise the parent/current branch truth table, including single versus joint confirmations and unaffected old branches, before narrowing OR to AND in one named branch. Do not globally transform other OR branches or infer profitable stop deletion from negative added-only PnL; that counterfactual requires a separately frozen full sequential replay.
